tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Brand pine: primary buttons, the bubble mark, links, the focus ring. White-label: tenants override it at runtime (--wl-primary-color). Carries `primary-content`. Deliberately not WhatsApp green (#25d366).

tokens.name: primary-content
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `primary` fills (button labels, the Arabic wordmark inside the bubble). Dark uses deep ink, not white.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover shade of `primary` (the Tailwind `primary-hover` utility; daisyUI has no hover role).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Clay/terracotta accent: the hero mark's tail, highlight chips, warmth against the pine. One per view alongside `primary`.

tokens.name: secondary-content
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm ochre accent role. Reserved for a third emphasis (landing detail); never competes with `primary` in one view.

tokens.name: accent-content
tokens.usage: Text on `accent`.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Deep ink band: the footer and waitlist bands (`bg-neutral text-neutral-content`), the inverted mark, and numbered step badges (`badge-neutral`).

tokens.name: neutral-content
tokens.usage: Text on `neutral` bands, and the inverted bubble fill.

tokens.name: base-100
tokens.usage: Page background, cards, inputs, the app header (at 95% with backdrop blur).

tokens.name: base-200
tokens.usage: Alternate section band (`Section tone="base-200"`), auth screen ground, code/copy fields.

tokens.name: base-300
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card borders, section top rules, FAQ dividers, input borders. Decorative only (below 3:1).

tokens.name: base-content
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `base-100` and `base-200`.

tokens.name: base-content-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: `text-base-content/75` — eyebrows, sub-heads, card bodies, hints, captions. Reads ≥ 4.5:1 on `base-100` and `base-200` in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: White-label muted text default (--color-text-muted). Prefer `base-content-muted` in new UI. The runtime keeps one value across themes.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational alerts. FLAG: white `info-content` on light `info` is ~4.1:1, under 4.5:1 for small text — use bold/large labels or `base-content` text on an `info`/10 tint.

tokens.name: info-content
tokens.usage: Text on `info`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success alerts and connected-session badges. Always pair with a word ("Connected"), never colour alone.

tokens.name: success-content
tokens.usage: Text on `success`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings and the one-time secret field (`CopyField secret`: `warning` border on a `warning`/10 tint).

tokens.name: warning-content
tokens.usage: Text on `warning`.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors: `alert-error`, `text-error` validation lines, destructive confirmations.

tokens.name: error-content
tokens.usage: Text on `error`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element (globals.css).

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero h1 at lg (text-5xl, tracking-tight). Steps down to 36/40 at sm and 30/36 on mobile. Rounded Fredoka, not a grotesque.
styles.sample: Turn your WhatsApp number into an AI teammate.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section h2 at sm+ (text-3xl, tracking-tight); 24/32 on mobile.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Kicker above every h1/h2: uppercase, tracking-wider, in `base-content-muted`.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Hero sub-head at sm+ (text-lg) in `base-content-muted`; 16/24 on mobile.
styles.sample: Connect your number, build paced auto-replies, and plug it into Claude.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: auth card title, admin page h1 (text-2xl).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Feature-card h3, FAQ questions (500). Headings wear the display face; body copy does not.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: WaFine sits between WhatsApp and your tools.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: The workhorse: card bodies, nav links, field labels (500), table cells (text-sm).
styles.sample: Scan a QR code once from WhatsApp Web.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: API keys, URLs and snippets in CopyField and admin tables (font-mono text-xs).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label-to-input gap (mt-1), icon gaps (gap-1).

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Field label bottom margin (mb-1.5).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default inline gap (gap-2): brand lockup, button rows, header items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card-body gap, heading-to-eyebrow (mt-3), button row gap in hero.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter (px-4), FAQ row padding, list rhythm (mb-4).

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards (gap-5), auth card-body gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card-body padding (daisyUI card-body 2rem); hero CTA top margin.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section heading to grid (mt-10); hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding on mobile (py-14).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section vertical padding at sm+ (py-20).

tokens.name: rounded-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons and pills read as rounded/playful (daisyUI --rounded-btn). Inputs, selects and textareas override to 0.875rem in globals.css — a pill textarea reads as a lens.

tokens.name: rounded-box
tokens.usage: Cards, the FAQ stack, the mobile menu panel (daisyUI --rounded-box).

tokens.name: rounded-badge
tokens.usage: Badges and pills (daisyUI --rounded-badge).

tokens.name: rounded-mark
tokens.usage: The icon tile radius: rx 112 on the 512 app icon.

tokens.name: elevation-rest
tokens.usage: Default depth: a `base-300` border, no shadow. App screens (auth, admin, settings) stay here.

tokens.name: elevation-raised
tokens.usage: Soft pine-tinted shadow: feature cards on hover, marked step badges. `shadow-raised`.

tokens.name: elevation-floating
tokens.usage: Deeper pine-tinted shadow: the hero chat-thread layer and other parallax panels. `shadow-floating`. Never neutral grey.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every interactive control (min-h-11 / h-11).

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App navbar min height (min-h-14), sticky.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Marketing content width (max-w-6xl) with a 16px gutter.

tokens.name: prose-width
tokens.usage: Centred section heading and FAQ width (max-w-3xl).

tokens.name: auth-width
tokens.usage: Login / sign-up card width (max-w-sm).

tokens.name: border-btn
tokens.usage: Button and card border width (daisyUI --border-btn).
